summary: Join us as a Software Engineer at Barclays, leading the design and development of enterprise-scale Java applications using modern frameworks and cloud-native architectures.
responsibilities: Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions
Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers
Collaboration with peers, participation in code reviews, and promotion of a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing
Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations
required_skills: Hands-on Java development (Java 8+ features, streams, lambdas, modules)
Advanced Spring ecosystem (Boot, Security, Data JPA, Cloud)
Deep understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection, and performance tuning
Expert-level knowledge of design patterns, SOLID principles, and clean code practices
nice_to_have_skills: Deploy and manage applications on GCP using Infrastructure as Code
Design CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability solutions (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack)
Optimize application performance and scalability in cloud environments
benefits: Promotion of a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing
